scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@cortex/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@cortex/web
scripts.lint: eslint . && uv run --directory services/api ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@cortex/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@cortex/web && uv run --directory services/api mypy
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --directory services/api python scripts/export_openapi.py && openapi-typescript services/api/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/generated/openapi.ts
scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- services/api/openapi.json packages/contracts/src/generated/openapi.ts
